name: DROWL Layouts
description: Provides DROWL's default ZURB Foundation layouts.
project_description: DROWL Layouts ships DROWL's set of ZURB Foundation (XY-Grid) based section layouts as Layout API / Layout Discovery plugins, usable in Layout Builder and Layout Paragraphs. It provides one-through-six-column layouts (stacked and unstacked variants), page/component layouts (Node Detail Default, Card, Media Object) and a CSS-grid based Dynamic Content Grid. Each configurable layout exposes per-section options: column widths, horizontal and vertical cell alignment (Foundation .align-* classes), section width (page/viewport width), collapsing grid gutters per device size, and free-text extra classes. All Foundation grid classes live in the Twig templates so the markup can be adapted to Bootstrap or another framework. The module depends on core Layout Discovery + Layout Builder and on Twig Real Content (used for realistic empty-region detection in previews). Because Foundation is effectively end-of-life the maintainers now recommend the successor project DROWL Layouts BS (Bootstrap).
